无生之地
时间缓缓流逝，隋缘在山谷中，白天随着龙啸一起翻山越岭、爬山崖、过深涧，晚上则随着青衣道长学习功法，日子过的倒也充实自在。
唯一让隋缘有些苦恼的就是，自己拿到这本功法已经半年了，到现在都没有一点修炼出内力的兆头，自从三个月前问过龙啸一次被其给嘲讽了一通后，隋缘已经绝了向龙啸打听这些事情的念头。
日子一天天的过去，隋缘虽然没有练出什么内力，但身体素质却是在不断的提升着，依着龙啸的说法，在不入流的武者中，勉强可以逃得性命。
听着这种可以说是额度的言语，隋缘有种把他的嘴巴给一拳打烂的冲动，接下来很长一段时间，每当隋缘感到自己坚持不下去的时候，只要一想到龙啸的嘴心中就又充满了仇恨的力量，这却是让龙啸奇怪了很久。
隋缘在山谷内日复一日的重复着自己的日子，却不知山谷外面早已经暗流涌动。
大梁国西北，这里是一片连绵千里的山脉，山势险峻、易守难攻，从千年前那个统一天下的大夏王朝覆灭后，这里便称为了山贼的老巢，千年来无数被朝廷通缉的大盗或者在中原混不下去的人不断的聚集在此，使得这里有了一个新的名字，无生之地。
无生，这是对那些想要剿灭匪徒或者自诩正派的人而言的，这些人，来此必死，对那些穷凶极恶之人而来，这里却是传说中的天堂，只因这里没有规矩，一切都是实力为尊。
千百年来，历任的朝廷都想要把无生之地彻底的纳入版图之中，然而最终的结果却都是功亏一篑，据说最接近成功的一次是三十年前大梁开国皇帝御驾亲征，携定鼎天下的大势征伐无生之地，这一战，大梁开国三十万精锐折损半数，大梁皇帝梁盛撤军后不久便归天西去了，从此后，大梁朝廷上下，无一人再敢提征讨无生之地的事情。
这天，这片令天下人闻之色变的连绵群山之中，一名青衣老者骑在一头明显是拉货用的驴子背上，驴子被一个十几岁的小童子牵着，两人一驴走在弯曲盘旋的小道上，两侧的群山之中不时有虎啸或者狼嚎声传来，一老一小却是面色如常，似是根本没有将其放在心上。
“老爷，大公子知道咱们要来，怎么没有派人来接咱们啊！”
前方，牵着毛驴的童子看着脚下蜿蜒着向前不知道延伸到哪里的小路，面上露出一抹苦色。
“怎么，走不动了！”
毛驴上的老者闻言笑了笑，目光从两侧的山林中收回，笑看着面前的小童。
“走不动倒不至于，”
小童闻言挠了挠头，“有些无聊倒是真的。”
“呵~”
老者闻言笑了声，“再有两个时辰就到了，到时候让你去山里玩个够。”
“当真！

？”
小童闻言豁然转身看来，面上神色又惊又喜。
“我什么时候骗过你吗？”
看着小童那期盼的眼神，老者笑问道。
“多谢老爷。”
小童闻言学着大人模样向老者拱手行了一礼。
“行了，”
挥了挥手，老者催促道，“快些赶路吧。”
“好嘞！”
小童答应一声，甩了甩手中的缰绳，牵着毛驴快步走了起来。
小路两侧的密林中，一道道身穿黑色劲装的身影快速的穿行着，林中茂密的枝叶未能阻拦他们分毫。
一路平平静静的走了两个时辰，当两人一驴转过一个弯，眼前豁然出现了一大片的平原，平原中央，一道旗杆高高的耸立，上面一块黑底的旗帜在山风中猎猎作响，眯眼看去，旗帜上一轮金色弯月忽隐忽现。
黑底黄月，若是龙啸在此定然能够认出，这是江湖上五大势力之一的问天楼特有的旗帜。

lifeless land
Time passed slowly. Sui Yuan was in the valley. During the day, he followed the roar of the dragon to climb mountains and ridges, climb cliffs, and cross deep ravines. At night, he studied the exercises with Taoist Master Qing Yi. His life was fulfilling and comfortable.
The only thing that bothered Sui Yuan was that it had been half a year since he got this technique, and he still had no sign of developing his inner strength. Since he asked Long Xiao three months ago and was ridiculed by him, Sui Yuan had given up the idea of ​​asking Long Xiao about these things.
As the days passed, although Sui Yuan had not developed any internal strength, his physical fitness was constantly improving. According to Long Xiao, among inferior warriors, he could barely escape with his life.
Listening to such words that could be said to be quotas, Sui Yuan had the urge to punch his mouth to pieces. For a long time, whenever Sui Yuan felt that he could not hold on, the thought of Long Xiao's mouth would fill his heart with the power of hatred. This made Long Xiao strange for a long time.
Sui Yuan repeated his days in the valley day after day, but he didn't know that there was already an undercurrent surging outside the valley.
In the northwest of Daliang Kingdom, there is a mountain range stretching for thousands of miles. The mountains are steep and easy to defend but difficult to attack. Since the fall of the Great Xia Dynasty that unified the world a thousand years ago, this place has been called the lair of bandits. For thousands of years, countless thieves wanted by the court or people who can't survive in the Central Plains have gathered here constantly, giving this place a new name, the Land of No Life.
Wusheng, this is for those who want to exterminate gangsters or those who claim to be upright. These people will die when they come here. For those who are extremely evil, this is the legendary paradise, just because there are no rules here, everything is based on strength.
For thousands of years, successive imperial courts have wanted to completely incorporate the Inanimate Land into their territory, but in the end they all fell short. It is said that the closest success was when the founding emperor of Daliang conquered the Dingtian in person thirty years ago. In this battle, half of the 300,000 elite soldiers who founded the Daliang Kingdom were lost. Emperor Liang Sheng of Daliang returned to the west shortly after withdrawing his troops. From then on, no one in the Daliang court dared to mention the conquest of the inanimate land.
On this day, in the rolling mountains that made people all over the world change their minds, an old man in green was riding on the back of a donkey that was obviously used for pulling goods. The donkey was led by a teenage boy. Two people and one donkey were walking on the winding path. From time to time, there were roars of tigers or howls of wolves from the mountains on both sides. However, the old man and the young one had normal expressions, as if they didn't take it to heart at all.
"Sir, the eldest son knew we were coming, why didn't he send someone to pick us up?"
Ahead, the boy leading the donkey looked at the path winding under his feet and extending to who knows where, with a bitter look on his face.
"Why, I can't walk!"
The old man on the donkey smiled when he heard this. He looked away from the mountains and forests on both sides and looked at the child in front of him with a smile.
"It doesn't matter if you can't walk,"
The child scratched his head when he heard this, "It's true that it's a little boring."
"Ha~"
The old man laughed when he heard the words, "It will be here in two hours. Then I will let you go and have fun in the mountains."
"Seriously!
? "
When the child heard this, he turned around suddenly, with a look of surprise and joy on his face.
"When have I ever lied to you?"
Looking at the child's expectant eyes, the old man asked with a smile.
"Thank you, sir."
Upon hearing this, the child imitated the behavior of an adult and bowed to the old man.
"Okay,"
Waving his hand, the old man urged, "Hurry up and hurry up."
"Okay!"
The boy agreed, shook off the reins in his hands, and started walking quickly leading the donkey.
In the dense forest on both sides of the path, figures in black costumes walked quickly through the forest. The dense branches and leaves in the forest failed to stop them at all.
After walking peacefully for two hours, two people and one donkeyAfter turning a corner, a large plain suddenly appeared in front of us. In the center of the plain, a flagpole stood tall, with a black flag on it flapping in the mountain wind. When you squinted, you could see a golden crescent moon flickering on the flag.
The yellow moon on a black background, if Long Xiao were here, he would definitely be able to recognize it. This is the unique flag of Wentian Tower, one of the five major forces in the world.
